title: Pure Herald
summary: The Herald Fairy Rituals with generic Ritual support and staples; the page's Drytron and Cyber Angel engines are left out. The page's one-card starter sends Herald of the Arc Light from the Extra Deck, and Arc Light is Forbidden in the TCG, so this list uses another line. Diviner of the Herald sends a Herald of Ultimateness from the Deck to become Level 14 and pays for Oracle of the Herald on its own. Once tributed, it summons a Level 2 Herald from the Deck. Herald of Ultimateness then negates any Special Summon or activation by sending a Fairy from the hand, so the small Heralds are both negation fuel and hand traps. The Heraldic Beast and Heraldry cards share the name but are a different archetype and stay out. Diviner, from 2021, is the newest Herald card.
main: Diviner of the Herald
Starter Tuner: sends a Fairy to raise its Level; tributed, summons a Level 2 Fairy from the Deck.
Herald of Ultimateness
Level 12 Ritual: discards a Fairy to negate a summon or any activation; Diviner sends a spare.
Herald of Perfection
Level 6 Ritual: discards a Fairy to negate an activation.
Herald of Orange Light
Hand trap with another Fairy: negates a monster effect; Level 2 Tuner.
Herald of Green Light
Hand trap with another Fairy: negates a Spell.
Herald of Purple Light
Hand trap with another Fairy: negates a Trap.
Herald of Creation
Discards to return Herald of Ultimateness from the GY to the hand.
Oracle of the Herald
Ritual Spell for Ultimateness; they can't respond to it.
Dawn of the Herald
Ritual Spell for Perfection; returns a Tribute to the hand.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Generic: searches a Ritual Spell and the Herald it names.
Herald of the Abyss
Forces them to send a monster of a declared Type and Attribute.
extra: Link-2 from two LIGHT Fairies: negates a Spell/Trap; recovers Rituals when destroyed.
Rank 2: returns a monster from the GY to the hand.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
